user.title: Connect to Emby
user.description:
Enter your Emby Server connection details.

You can find your **API Key** in your Emby Server Dashboard under **Advanced > API Keys**.

data_description.host: The IP address (e.g., 192.168.1.5) or hostname of your server.
data_description.api_key: A dedicated API key created in your Emby Dashboard.

reconfigure.title: Update connection to {name}
reconfigure.description: Change the address or credentials Home Assistant uses to reach this Emby server. Your devices, entities and automations are kept.

data_description.host: The new IP address (e.g., 192.168.1.5) or hostname of your server.
data_description.api_key: Leave blank to keep the current API key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Emby Server. Check your IP and Port.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API Key. Please verify the key in your Emby Dashboard.

abort.already_configured: This Emby server is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Connection details updated. The integration has been reloaded.
abort.wrong_server: That address belongs to a different Emby server. To switch servers, add it as a new integration instead.
